name: DigiLab TK: FTO Duurzaamheid
description: DigiLab TK institutes from the FTO Duurzaamheid use case, sharing greenhouse-gas and air-quality measurements from satellite, atmosphere, field and lab. Records follow DCAT-AP 3.0.1 and name the data standard of their payload in dct:conformsTo, which the Vocabulary Hub resolves and aligns. Institutes and facility types come from the use case; datasets, standard versions, alignment coverage and one deliberately incomplete record are illustrative.

assets.name: Eddy-covariance CO2 and CH4 fluxes, peat meadow
assets.description: Half-hourly CO2 and CH4 fluxes from an eddy-covariance mast in a drained peat meadow, quality-controlled and gap-filled. Used to study how water-level management changes greenhouse-gas emissions from peat soils.

assets.name: Raw 10 Hz logger stream, peat meadow mast
assets.description: Unprocessed 10 Hz wind and gas readings as the field logger writes them, from the same mast as the peat meadow fluxes. Input for the flux processing chain, not yet comparable with other sites.

assets.name: Dissolved greenhouse gases in water samples
assets.description: Concentrations of dissolved CO2, CH4 and N2O in surface-water and pore-water samples taken in the field and analysed in the lab by gas chromatography.

assets.name: Floating-chamber fluxes, fresh surface water
assets.description: Diffusive and ebullitive CH4 and CO2 fluxes from automated floating chambers on ditches and lakes, served as observations per chamber.

assets.name: Tall-tower CO2 and CH4 mole fractions
assets.description: Continuous CO2 and CH4 mole fractions measured at several heights on a tall atmospheric research tower, calibrated to the WMO scales.

dct:title.value: Hourly mole fractions, ICOS Atmosphere Level 2

assets.name: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI methane over the Netherlands
assets.description: Column-averaged methane (XCH4) from the TROPOMI instrument on Sentinel-5P, cut out over the Netherlands and the North Sea.

assets.name: National air quality network, hourly
assets.description: Hourly NO2, PM10, PM2.5, O3 and NH3 concentrations from the national air quality monitoring network, in the form reported to the European Environment Agency.

assets.name: Atmospheric transport model output
assets.description: Gridded CH4 and NH3 concentration fields from an atmospheric transport model, used to link measured concentrations to emission sources.

assets.name: Gridded greenhouse-gas emission inventory
assets.description: CO2 and CH4 emissions per source sector on a high-resolution grid, used as prior for inverse modelling and for comparison with satellite observations.

assets.name: Urban CO2 measuring network
assets.description: CO2 and air-quality readings from a network of sensors across an urban area, served as live observations per sensor.

assets.name: Mobile measurement campaign, emission plumes
assets.description: Plume transects of CH4, NH3 and CO2 measured from a mobile laboratory around point sources. Deliberately incomplete: the record names no data standard, so the Vocabulary Hub has nothing to resolve and no search by data standard finds it.

assets.name: Dairy barn NH3 and CH4 emissions
assets.description: Ammonia and methane emissions from an experimental dairy barn with separate compartments, measured per compartment to compare emission-reducing measures.

assets.name: Field-site eddy-covariance fluxes
assets.description: Half-hourly CO2, water and energy fluxes from an eddy-covariance mast at a field research site for interactions between soil, water, atmosphere and biodiversity.
